ideas.name: Signal Room
ideas.tagline: Find the change that matters to your clients.
ideas.problem: Teams may spend more time collecting AI news than translating it into a useful client decision.
ideas.solution: A short evidence-led briefing linking a change, its commercial implication and a next action.
ideas.whyNow: Test the hypothesis that information overload increases demand for concise judgement.
ideas.distribution: Offer a sample briefing to five small agencies for feedback.
ideas.priceHypothesis: Test a paid weekly briefing; do not assume subscription demand.
ideas.falsificationTest: Ask readers to name a decision they changed; stop if the briefing only generates compliments.
uncertainties: The problem has not been validated with intended users.
Existing alternatives and willingness to pay require research.

sources.title: Deployment capability reference
sources.claim: Illustrative infrastructure context only. This is not evidence of customer demand for this example.

challenges.rationale: Illustrative score only. This concept needs customer research before a commercial test.
challenges.strongestObjection: An existing tool or a simple manual process may already solve the problem adequately.

pages.headline: Know what changes your next move.
pages.subhead: A considered briefing for teams who need to turn emerging technology into useful decisions.

benefits.title: Start with evidence
benefits.body: Give the important detail a place to live, with enough context to use it later.

benefits.title: Challenge the headline
benefits.body: Work through one focused question and leave with a clearer direction.

benefits.title: Choose your next move
benefits.body: Turn the idea into a small experiment you can actually try.

steps: Bring one real problem you want to work on.
Work through a short, focused first session.
Leave with one useful next action.
